title: Predictable performance is suboptimal, and what it means for model routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.31428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) differ in capabilities and costs, motivating routing methods that adaptively choose a model for each query. These methods rely on performance prediction: given a query, estimate whether a model will answer it correctly. Most routing methods train separate predictors of candidate models' performance to guide model selection. Our work shows that performance prediction only beats a simple baseline when the candidate model is suboptimal on the task or the performance predictor adds significant capacity relative to the candidate model. Specifically, we take a model's self-confidence, the probability it assigns to its chosen answer, as a baseline and study how much a performance predictor can improve on it. First, we show that any performance predictor that outperforms a model's self-confidence can be used to improve the model's loss: the predictor's advantage transfers exactly in log loss through recalibration. translated_title: 可预测的性能是次优的，以及这对模型路由的意义
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在能力和成本上各不相同，这促使人们开发能够为每个查询自适应选择模型的路由方法。这些方法依赖于性能预测：给定一个查询，估计某个模型是否能正确回答该查询。大多数路由方法通过训练独立的预测器来预测候选模型的性能，以指导模型选择。我们的工作表明，只有当候选模型在任务上表现次优，或者性能预测器相对于候选模型具有显著更强的能力时，性能预测才能超越一个简单的基线。具体而言，我们以模型的自我置信度（即模型分配给其所选答案的概率）作为基线，研究性能预测器能在多大程度上对其有所改进。首先，我们证明任何优于模型自我置信度的性能预测器都可以用来改进模型的损失：通过重新校准，预测器的优势可以在对数损失上被精确地转移。
tldr: 本文证明性能预测只有在候选模型本身表现次优或预测器具有显著更强能力时才能超越模型自身的置信度基线，且预测器的优势可通过重新校准在对数损失上被精确转移，这对模型路由方法的设计具有重要启示。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that performance prediction only beats a model's self-confidence baseline when the candidate model is suboptimal or the predictor adds significant capacity, and that a predictor's advantage transfers exactly in log loss through recalibration, with important implications for model routing.
